rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for your interest in Halcyon Threshold. Unfortunately, my current employment contract requires HR approval before I can make public statements or be quoted by name in press. I'm working through that process but won't have clearance by your deadline. I appreciate the interest and hope we can connect once I have that sorted out. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined reporter quote (Tessa Brandt) - cited contract constraints

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks so much for reaching out! Your offer to help is really valuable. I'm currently working on developing a more concrete project plan and potentially applying for a small grant to support the work. I'd love to have a conversation about what you're interested in and how we might collaborate. Are you free for a call sometime this week or next? What I'm most excited about is identifying neglected but tractable problems in AI safety — things that fall between the cracks of what big labs and major research institutions are working on. Your data analysis skills could be really useful for that kind of work. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Positive response to Priya's offer to help - opened door for collaboration
